text: This narrative review searched MEDLINE and Scopus up to 15 July 2026. We focused on prospective biomaterials studies. The examples are illustrative; completeness is not claimed.
gold_reason: 简洁叙述综述已给出书目来源、截止日期、选择逻辑和非全面覆盖边界；completeness is not claimed 应被识别为有效边界。

text: This narrative review searched Web of Science through June 2026. Studies were prioritized when candidates were prospectively fabricated. This was an illustrative selection rather than an exhaustive census.
gold_reason: 没有 Methods 标题不构成缺陷；叙述综述的范围披露已经充分且诚实。

text:
Methods
This narrative review used search keywords: hydrogel, polymer, peptide, scaffold, tissue engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning. Studies were discussed if relevant.
gold_reason: Methods 标题不能补足数据库、日期和覆盖边界；逗号分隔的长关键词库存仍是不可重跑的伪检索式。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 2026. Search terms were hydrogel; polymer; peptide; scaffold; tissue engineering. The concepts biomaterial OR hydrogel AND machine learning were considered. We selected illustrative studies rather than an exhaustive census.
gold_reason: 两个 Boolean 词和概念组合不足以构成数据库特异、可重跑的检索式。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed and Embase through 1 August 2026. We selected prospective materials experiments; this is not an exhaustive census. The Supplementary Search Strategy contains database-specific executable strings, run dates, eligibility rules, version handling, and the included-record manifest.
gold_reason: 主文保持简洁，并明确指向真实存在、含数据库特异字符串和运行日期的补充检索记录。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 2026. Inclusion and exclusion criteria were predefined; duplicate records were removed; two reviewers screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; the PRISMA flow diagram reports identified, screened, and excluded records. A Supplementary Search Strategy will be added before submission.
gold_reason: 未来拟添加的 supplement 不是现存检索记录；系统综述仍缺实际可执行检索式或已提供的补充文件。

text: This systematic literature review searched MEDLINE and Scopus from inception through 20 July 2026. The MEDLINE query was (hydrogel[Title/Abstract] AND machine learning[Title/Abstract]); the Scopus query was TITLE-ABS-KEY(hydrogel AND machine learning). Eligibility criteria were prespecified. Duplicate records were removed. Two reviewers independently screened titles and abstracts and then full texts. A PRISMA flow chart accounts for all records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: 虽无 Methods 标题，但各数据库可执行式、日期、纳排、文献去重、双人筛选和流程记录齐全。

text:
METHODS
We conducted a systematic review of PubMed through 2026. Search terms: hydrogel; polymer; peptide; scaffold. Inclusion and exclusion criteria were predefined. Duplicate records were removed. Two reviewers independently screened titles and abstracts and full text. The PRISMA diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: Methods 标题和关键词库存不能替代数据库特异可执行检索式。

text: This scoping review searched PubMed and Embase through 12 May 2026. Inclusion and exclusion criteria were prespecified. Duplicate records were removed. Two reviewers independently screened titles/abstracts and full texts. The PRISMA-ScR flow diagram accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. Supplementary Table S1 contains each database-specific search strategy and run date.
gold_reason: 范围综述的数据库、日期、纳排、去重、双人筛选、PRISMA-ScR 流程和真实补充检索策略齐全。

text: 本研究为范围综述，截至2026年7月检索PubMed和中国知网。预先规定纳入与排除标准，完成去重，由两名审阅者独立进行题名、摘要与全文筛选，PRISMA流程图记录检出、筛选与排除数量。附录S1列出各数据库可直接运行的完整检索式及运行日期。
gold_reason: 截至日期、中国知网、纳排与筛选流程均明确，附录 S1 明示包含各数据库可运行的完整检索式。

text: This meta-analysis searched Web of Science and Embase through 2025. Web of Science used TS=(hydrogel AND regeneration), and Embase used exp hydrogel/ AND exp regeneration/. Eligibility criteria were predefined. Duplicate records were removed. Two reviewers independently screened title/abstract and full text. The PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: 荟萃分析给出 WoS 与 Embase 各自语法，并完整报告系统检索和筛选结构。

text: We did not conduct a systematic review. Instead, this focused update uses purposive examples to explain emerging biomaterials methods.
gold_reason: did not conduct 是明确否定，不得因后续出现 systematic review 字样而触发系统综述门禁。

text: 本文并未开展系统综述，而是以代表性研究开展叙事性证据综合，不据此估计文献覆盖率。
gold_reason: 并未开展系统综述是中文明确否定；文章属于叙述性综合，但来源和日期仍未披露完整。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 2026. We selected representative experiments; this is not an exhaustive census. Publisher platforms were used only for full-text retrieval, whereas DOI landing pages were used only to verify metadata and publication status.
gold_reason: PubMed、全文获取和 DOI 元数据/发表状态核验的角色已经清楚分开，不应再报角色缺失。

text: This narrative review searched Scopus through August 2026. We selected illustrative prospective studies rather than an exhaustive census. An author-curated full-text collection, assembled from monthly alerts between 2020 and 2026, supplied additional records; every record was screened under the same selection logic and its source was logged.
gold_reason: 作者全文库的形成方式、时间范围、记录进入流程和来源记录均已披露，边界提示不应无条件触发。

text: 本叙述性综述检索PubMed至2026年8月，优先选择完成前瞻实验验证的研究，所选案例并非穷尽性统计。出版社平台仅用于获取全文，DOI落地页仅用于核验元数据和发表状态。
gold_reason: 中文文本已明确书目检索、全文获取和 DOI 核验角色，不应重复报警。

text: This systematic review searched CINAHL from inception through 30 June 2026 using (MH "Biomaterials+") AND machine learning. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; duplicate records were removed; two reviewers independently screened titles/abstracts and full text; a PRISMA flow diagram accounts for identified, screened, and excluded records.
gold_reason: CINAHL 是书目数据库，MH 是其受控主题词语法；其余系统检索结构完整。

text: The reporting discussion follows the Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews and the PRISMA guidance. The article itself is an invited critical overview of model selection, based on illustrative examples.
gold_reason: 领域指南书名中的 Systematic Reviews 不是本文文体声明；invited critical overview 也未明确等同 narrative/systematic/scoping/meta。

text: Under the invited Review format, the journal requests that no standalone Methods heading be used. This narrative review searched MEDLINE through 31 July 2026; we selected studies with external validation and used them as illustrative examples rather than an exhaustive census.
gold_reason: 目标期刊文体不设 Methods 标题，但来源、日期、选择逻辑与覆盖边界均充分；领域/期刊要求应优先。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 2026. Search terms were biomaterial; hydrogel; polymer; peptide; machine learning. We selected illustrative cases. The search was NOT systematic AND coverage was not estimated.
gold_reason: 覆盖边界句中的 NOT/AND 不是检索式 Boolean 证据，不能让分号关键词库存升级为 executable query。

text: We conducted a systematic review in PubMed through 2026 using (hydrogel[tiab] AND machine learning[tiab]). Inclusion and exclusion criteria were predefined. Two reviewers independently screened titles/abstracts and full texts. A PRISMA flow diagram reports identified, screened, and excluded records. In the applications section, generative-model candidate deduplication is recommended before synthesis.
gold_reason: 应用章节的材料候选去重不是文献记录去重；系统综述仍缺 bibliographic deduplication，必须判 incomplete。
